issues.detail: The instructions lack coverage of error scenarios and edge cases.

scenarios.name: deploy-service-with-canary
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required --source flag and most of the other flags, whereas Response A uses --image and omits --set-env-vars, making B the better answer.

scenarios.name: create-and-execute-job
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes all required flags exactly as specified, while Response B uses the incorrect --timeout flag instead of --task-timeout, missing a key rubric element.

scenarios.name: update-service-env-and-secrets
scenarios.rationale: Response A exactly matches the required command and flags, while Response B uses placeholders, incorrect flag names, and does not meet the rubric.
